message: We've added experimental support for converting text-based subtitles to PGS (.sup). Furthermore, we've significantly improved subpicture conversion performance in Chrome. Give it a try and let us know if you hit any issues!

Welcome to our revamped site! We hope you love the fresh look. As always, if you have a feature request, spot a bug, or see anything we can improve, please let us know via our [contact page](/contact/). Thanks for your support!
